payload.description_html:
Yeah the stitching on here is absolutely horrible, but I'm uploading it anyway, just to give you a sense of how big this darn thing was.

Tylosaurus pembinensis skeleton, Canadian Fossil Discovery Centre, Morden MB.

Mosasaurs were large aquatic reptiles that lived during the Cretaceous period.
